description: This file is a Next.js page component that renders a blog post. It imports content processing utilities, fetches post data asynchronously, transforms and renders the post content, and generates metadata for SEO and static site generation.

classes.name: PageClient
classes.description: React component responsible for rendering the blog post content on the client side.

methods.name: Page
